remote_view.address_label.note: Shown by the Windows app and by another host's app, in the same words.

remote_view.bridged_untried.en: This machine is bridged. Viewing from other devices is made for the shared network, and hasn't been tried bridged yet.

remote_view.cancel.note: Shown by the Windows app and by another host's app, in the same words.

remote_view.closed_text.declined.en: Closed. The device was turned away. Press Pair a New Device to try again.

remote_view.code_label.note: What a screen reader says on another host, whose app shows the time left as a running countdown of its own.

remote_view.code_time_left.note: The Linux app's line for a waiting device: its code and the seconds left to answer.

remote_view.compare_code_line.en: Check that this code matches the one shown on the device before you press Accept.

remote_view.devices_title.en: Devices that can view this machine

remote_view.fingerprint_label.note: Shown by the Windows app and by another host's app, in the same words.

remote_view.headline.failed.en: The screen could not be shared: {why}

remote_view.headline.not_running.en: On. The screen is shared once the machine is running.

remote_view.headline.off.en: Off. Nothing is listening for other devices.

remote_view.headline.ready.en: Ready. A paired device can connect.

remote_view.held_while_pairing.en: Clipboard sharing with this PC pauses until pairing closes.

remote_view.network_warning.en: Devices on the same network can reach this machine's screen once they are paired.

remote_view.no_devices.en: No device has been paired yet. Press Pair a New Device to add one.

remote_view.only_notice.en: {name} is showing this machine on its own screen only, so there is no picture here. It comes back when {name} leaves.
remote_view.only_notice.note: Says the picture comes back when the device leaves, which is true on the Linux host. The Windows host's own window does not come back by itself, so the Windows app shows remote_view.takes_screen instead.

remote_view.open_time_left.note: What a screen reader says on another host, whose app shows the time left as a running countdown of its own.

remote_view.paired_hint.en: A device that is already paired connects to the address above. To add another device, press Pair a New Device.

remote_view.pairing_note.en: Only devices you accepted here can connect. Anyone on the same network can ask to pair while pairing is open.

remote_view.pairing_steps.1.en: In remoteman on the other device, add a computer and enter the address above.

remote_view.pairing_steps.2.en: If remoteman shows a fingerprint, check that it matches the one above.

remote_view.pairing_steps.3.en: The device waits, and its name and a code appear here. Check that the code matches the one on the device, then press Accept. Pairing closes when the device has been answered, or when the time is up.

remote_view.remove_message.en: It will be disconnected and will have to be paired again to view this machine.

remote_view.screen_line.en: {name} has this machine's screen now. Open screen takes it back.
remote_view.screen_line.note: True on a host whose guest serves one device at a time, its own window included, and whose window does not connect again by itself: the Windows host. The Linux host says remote_view.only_notice instead.

remote_view.spoken_code.note: What a screen reader says for the code in the Windows app: the digits one by one, with a space between each.

remote_view.switch_name.note: Shown by the Windows app and by another host's app, in the same words.

remote_view.takes_screen.en: One device shows this machine at a time, so {name} has its screen and the machine's window here has lost it. Open screen takes it back, and {name}'s view ends. Neither connects again by itself.
remote_view.takes_screen.note: True on a host whose guest serves one device at a time, its own window included, and whose window does not connect again by itself: the Windows host. The Linux host says remote_view.only_notice instead.

remote_view.waiting_time_left.note: What a screen reader says on another host, whose app shows the time left as a running countdown of its own.
